newsitem.title: RUSSIA: LUKoil leads Russian shares higher on ADR news.
newsitem.headline: LUKoil leads Russian shares higher on ADR news.

text.p: Leading Russian shares opened higher on Thursday, after LUKoil said it had received approval for an issue of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) on its preferred shares , traders said.
LUKoil preferred were $13.00 at 1040 GMT, off an earlier $13.45 after the ADR news, but well up on Wednesday's closing $11.75. LUKoil ordinaries were $15.30 after closing at $15.10.
"Everything is rallying behind LUKoil," said Peter Kizenko, chief trader at ING Barings.
The Russian Trading System 24-share Index edged up to 307.64 at 0900 GMT from Wednesday's close of 306.74, on medium to light volume.
"It's hard to categorise which sectors are doing better," said Viktor Pitaleff of Renaissance Capital. "It's very broad based."
Kizenko said local buyers were leading the trading, with bids from New York left over from Wednesday also fuelling demand.
Traders said Norilsk Nickel was also attracting strong interest, rising to $6.85 from $6.80.
Some dealers said the strong market would continue into next week, but others saw it consolidating at current levels.
"I think we're seeing share prices coming into a new balance," said Pavel Naumenko of CS First Boston. "The market is forming a new level."
